verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because a government online service that holds taxpayer data could plausibly state whether that data is used for AI training or offer an opt-out. The evidence pack contains no such policy or control. The robots.txt disallow on /e-services/ only limits crawler access, which is an adjacent control and not a way for users to stop their data being used for training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
